name: Man, I Hate That Indie Game!
source:
Some cute girls who are interested in indie games are in need of your help! Do you love indie games enough to be useful? Choose your route carefully, and you may end up a winner!

[From [url=http://www.xboxindies.com/game/man-i-hate-that-indie-game-]Xbox Indies[/url]]

几位对独立游戏感兴趣的可爱女孩，正需要你的帮助！你对独立游戏的热爱，足够让你帮上忙吗？谨慎选择路线，或许最终就能成为赢家！
